newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EMU DELAY WOULD PUSH UP OLO/BUND SPREAD -JP MORGAN.
newsitem.headline: EMU DELAY WOULD PUSH UP OLO/BUND SPREAD -JP MORGAN.

text.p: A delay in European Monetary Union (EMU) would push up Belgian short rates and send the 10-year yield spread between linear bonds and Bunds towards 50 basis points, investment house JP Morgan said on Monday.
"Pressure on Bfr/DM pushes up short rates versus Germany and prevents the Belgian National Bank from following the Bundesbank," JP Morgan said in a research note on the impact of a delay for EMU.
It said some domestic investors would diversify part of their holdings into Bunds.
The OLO/Bund 10-year yield would move towards 50 basis points to cover longer-run currency risks and concerns about long-term commitment to fiscal discipline, it said.
"This spread equals Belgium's real-yield spread to Germany before EMU became a factor," it said.
At 1515 GMT, the 10-year OLO/Bund spread was at 13 basis points.
